user.title: HomeBrain
user.description: Add the HomeBrain panel to the sidebar.

init.title: Entity bindings
init.description: Choose the module whose bindings you want to edit.

waste.title: Waste entity bindings
waste.description: Select sensors or a calendar for the waste module. Clear a field to remove its binding.

energy.title: Energy entity bindings
energy.description: Select sensors for the energy module. Power in W or kW, daily energy in kWh, price in CZK/kWh. Clear a field to remove its binding. Appliances: power, total energy (kWh, total_increasing) and an optional switch – HomeBrain only reads switches, it never controls them.

data.energy_grid_l1_power: Grid power phase L1 at the meter, signed: import +, export − (W/kW, optional)
data.energy_grid_l2_power: Grid power phase L2 at the meter, signed: import +, export − (W/kW, optional)
data.energy_grid_l3_power: Grid power phase L3 at the meter, signed: import +, export − (W/kW, optional)
data.energy_grid_l1_current: Grid current phase L1 at the meter (A, optional – otherwise estimated from power)
data.energy_grid_l2_current: Grid current phase L2 at the meter (A, optional – otherwise estimated from power)
data.energy_grid_l3_current: Grid current phase L3 at the meter (A, optional – otherwise estimated from power)
data.energy_main_breaker: Main breaker rating per phase, e.g. input_number with 25 (A, optional, default 25 A)
data.energy_spot_price_electricity: Electricity spot price now, with price series attributes
data.energy_inverter_power: Inverter AC output power (W/kW, + to the house, − charging from the grid, optional)
data.energy_tariff_price_vt: Tariff price high rate VT (CZK/kWh incl. VAT, optional)
data.energy_tariff_price_nt: Tariff price low rate NT (CZK/kWh incl. VAT, optional)
data.energy_tariff_fixed_monthly: Fixed monthly fees (CZK/month incl. VAT, optional)
data.energy_spot_distribution_vt: Spot comparison: distribution VT incl. fees and VAT (CZK/kWh, optional)
data.energy_spot_distribution_nt: Spot comparison: distribution NT incl. fees and VAT (CZK/kWh, optional)
data.energy_spot_markup: Spot comparison: supplier markup (CZK/kWh excl. VAT, optional)
data.energy_spot_fixed_monthly: Spot comparison: fixed monthly fees (CZK/month incl. VAT, optional)

family.title: Family calendar bindings
family.description: Select the family and school calendars. HomeBrain only reads them; Today shows today's events (title and time) on the timeline. Clear a field to remove the binding.

energy_pv.title: PV system (forecast and advice)
energy_pv.description: All fields are optional. kWp enables the Open-Meteo forecast fallback, used only when no forecast integration in the HA Energy dashboard provides data. Azimuth uses the Open-Meteo convention: 0° = south, −90° = east, 90° = west. Without tilt HomeBrain assumes 35° and says so. Limits and battery capacity let the advice detect a full battery and curtailed surplus.

recipes.title: Recipes entity bindings
recipes.description: Optional. The music bar and the airfryer action stay hidden until these are bound. HomeBrain starts the airfryer only after an explicit confirmation in cooking mode. The music notify target (notify.mobile_app_<tablet>) is set in Recipes → Settings.

data.recipes_media_session: Kitchen tablet media session sensor (HA Companion, optional)
